name: atom-audit
description: Shows which atoms repeat each other's code and which are large enough to check for a second noun, so Victor can decide what to move to the kit, merge, or split. Changes nothing.

verbs.name: scan
verbs.description: Repeated code, the atom pairs that share the most of it, and the atoms over 300 source lines. With --base, the result also holds the repeated code that the base folder lacks, and the text shows only that. Free.

minSize.description: Fewest syntax nodes a clone must hold.

atoms.description: Folder holding one folder per atom. This repo's atoms folder by default.

base.description: Another atoms folder, such as main's. The result then lists the repeated code that this folder has and the base does not.
